title: LocusMcpGrantMint
description: Output of `locus mcp mint --binding <alias> --json` — a multi-tenant MCP grant (sealed session + bearer token). The token is printed exactly once; only its HMAC is stored at rest under $LOCUS_HOME/mcp-grants/. Hubs MUST hold the token in memory only (never log, persist, or place it in tool arguments) and present it as the X-Locus-Tenant-Token header on every /mcp request against `locus-mcp --http --multi-tenant`. $defs.listEntry describes one row of `locus mcp list --json`, which is values-free (never tokens).

grant_id.description: Stable grant identifier (also embedded in the token as lmt_<grant_id>.<secret>). Safe to log and audit.

token.description: One-time-shown tenant bearer token. MEMORY ONLY: hand it to the worker as a header value for the job's duration, then revoke the grant. Never persisted, logged, or placed in tool arguments.

session_id.description: Sealed delegated session backing the grant (values-free identity metadata).

binding.description: Binding alias the grant is hard-scoped to.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 grant expiry. Expired grants answer 401 with reason=grant_expired and are swept; re-mint rather than extend.

label.description: Free-form operator label (e.g. hub job id); shown by `locus mcp list`.

serve.description: Informational serving hint from the CLI.

listEntry.title: LocusMcpGrantListEntry
listEntry.description: One row of `locus mcp list --json` (operator-only roster; there is deliberately no HTTP enumeration). Values-free: never contains tokens.

live_http_sessions.description: Live (non-expired) tenant HTTP sessions bound to this grant — diff against the hub job table to catch leaked grants.
